parameters.name: From
parameters.description:
The source of the data request. Default value: **aqs**. Valid values:
- **sas**: The data request comes from Security Center.
- **aqs**: The data request comes from Server Guard.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the asset group to query.
> You can call the [DescribeAllGroups](~~130972~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: Remark
parameters.description: The asset name or public IP address.
